hypothesis: Among positive 12-1 momentum top-tercile stocks, greater trailing 126-session cumulative intraday log return identifies persistent buying better than total momentum alone. Overnight attribution is a competing control, not a separately selected winner.
throughReason: Exclude September's previously documented replay final-session quote defect, before computing new outcomes.
chronology: Fixed rules; no model, learned transform, hyperparameter search or label training. Signal at previous KRX session close; entry at next session close. Nonoverlapping holding windows. Development/evaluation cohorts separated by a 21-session embargo after developmentEnd; crossing cohorts excluded from split comparisons, retained in full exploratory path. No claim of untouched OOS.
selection: PIT Top120 snapshot strictly older than signal; name-based preferred exclusion; all 253 consecutive KRX observations required. Reject past close jumps >32% or listed-share jumps >10% (conservative corporate-action ambiguity gate). Positive raw 12-1 return; top third by momentum; intraday book chooses five largest trailing126 sum(log(close/open)); controls choose momentum or overnight=sum(log(close/previous_close))-intraday; ticker tie break. Max two per reconstructed industry; unknown industry not eligible. Unfilled 20% slots use ETF. Hybrid uses 50% candidate book and 50% ETF. No outcome-dependent replacement.

costs.note: KOSPI combined transaction/rural tax; exact 2019-06-03 reduction from 30 to 25bp. 2025 15bp, 2026 20bp per existing repository dated schedule, not independently legal-certified; doubled all-in cost sensitivity. ETF domestic equity tax=0; same commission/spread as stocks, intentionally conservative. Every candidate H-block liquidates and re-enters, even same names; passive ETF reference buys once and exits once per analysis window. Gross distributions before investor dividend tax; not payment-date executable wealth.

conditionalSample: Second sample excludes all 22 already inventoried terminated names and known unresolved 006800.KS basis for entire history. Explicit hindsight/survivor condition; not implementable PIT universe. Strict sample retains their signal selection and blocks unpriceable held paths. Never assign terminal zero or last-price payoff.
returnBasis: Stocks: existing replay split-continuous, partial-distribution accumulated index; not complete shareholder total return. ETF: existing corrected/reconciled gross distribution index. Raw KRX volume independently required at entry/exit and each valuation session. No fill, no simulated liquidation of missing names. All daily statistics use contiguous nonoverlapping paths, never stitched valid blocks.
uncertainty: Paired block excesses reported with actual n per comparison. Fixed-seed year-cluster bootstrap descriptive intervals when >=6 years and >=12 blocks; otherwise unavailable. No p-value or SUPPORTED/promotion claim. History has been inspected in earlier studies.
tuning: None. Protocol stored before first new return execution. All specified books, both horizons, both samples and 1x/2x costs reported regardless of sign.
production: NONE; no prospective receipts, recommendations, sealed executors, workflow edits or main merge
